name: What information do I need to provide for an accurate countertop installation quote?
description: For an accurate quote, provide your layout, desired material, edge style, specific features, and photos of your space.

mainEntity.name: What information do I need to provide for an accurate countertop installation quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get an accurate quote for countertop installation, you should provide details about your kitchen or bathroom layout, including preliminary measurements, desired material type (e.g., granite, quartz, laminate), preferred edge style, and any specific features like sink cutouts or backsplashes. Photos of your current space can also be very helpful. Gathering these details beforehand allows Frasheski Construction to provide a more precise estimate and identify potential complexities early in the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: For an accurate quote, provide your layout, desired material, edge style, specific features, and photos of your space.
